description: List the repositories in this company's org-level repo index, with activity classification (active = pushed recently, stable = no recent pushes, deprecated = archived), whether each repo already has an AnyForge analysis, and its known coverage %. Use this FIRST when scoping a program to discover candidate codebases. Defaults to active repos. To scope a coverage/quality program in one shot, pass belowCoverage (e.g. 90) — returns only repos with known coverage below it, worst-first. The result includes total counts so you know how many were omitted by the cap.

belowCoverage.description: Only repos with KNOWN coverage below this % (worst-first). Repos with unknown coverage are excluded.

name: anyforge_list_repo_index
title: List repo index
